purpose: Teach: 激変/奪取/過密/浸水/殿堂/リンチ/撃破/国力

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 桜さん、社会が激変した事例を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Sakura, you wrote your paper on a case of dramatic social transformation, didn't you?
lines.style: Warm, curious opening. Genuine interest in the answer. Steady pace, teacher's natural authority held lightly. Not checking — already knows.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、領土奪取を巡る戦争史を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I focused on territorial conquest and the history of war surrounding it.
lines.style: Clear and direct. Slight formality in register — respectful of the classroom context. Even delivery. Meeting her teacher's eyes with the confidence of prepared work.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 都市の過密問題を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: And you also addressed urban overcrowding in another piece, if I recall?
lines.style: Gentle confirmation rather than quiz. Slight lift at the end — inviting elaboration. Warm but maintaining professional distance. Teacher's natural rhythm.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、洪水で建物が浸水した事例を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I examined a case where flooding caused building submersion and displacement.
lines.style: Steady, matter-of-fact delivery. No apology in the tone — she owns the work. Maintains eye contact with her answer. Clear articulation of the technical details.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 音楽家が殿堂入りした事例を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: You also wrote about a musician's induction into the hall of fame, as I remember?
lines.style: Gentle, appreciative. The tone of a teacher noting the breadth of a student's interests. Slight smile underneath — genuinely interested in where this is going. Conversational warmth.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、人種を狙ったリンチの歴史を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I investigated the history of racial violence and targeted lynching movements.
lines.style: Serious tone shift here. Steady, unflinching delivery of a difficult subject. No flinching, no apology — just the weight of the topic itself. Respectful gravity.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 近代戦における要塞撃破史を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: And for your final submission, you explored fortress destruction in modern warfare?
lines.style: Returning to the measured, reflective pace. Recognition in the voice — this student works across complex domains. Slight pause before 'final' — acknowledging the scope of her work.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、国力の指標研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I examined the research methodologies used to measure national power indices.
lines.style: Closing with quiet confidence. The final answer carries the ease of someone who has done thorough work. Slight softness at the end — almost relief that the check-in is complete. Not rushed.
